data.name: ONNX Runtime v1.31.0
data.body:
ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 stabilizes model-package and EPContext data APIs, improves CPU model loading and quantized MoE inference, expands device-based execution-provider selection, and strengthens model-loading and runtime reliability. These notes cover changes since ONNX Runtime 1.30.0. CUDA and WebGPU kernel updates are summarized here; detailed provider notes are covered by their separate plugin EP releases.

## Highlights

- Promoted the model-package API and EPContext data callbacks to stable C and C++ APIs, with EPContext callback support added across language bindings ([#33166](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33166), [#32265](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32265)).
- Reduced CPU session-initialization overhead by parallelizing eligible weight prepacking, and accelerated block-wise INT4/INT8 QMoE experts with MLAS QNBit kernels and grouped expert dispatch ([#31691](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31691), [#32644](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32644), [#32668](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32668)).
- Added x86 FP16 LayerNorm/RMSNorm acceleration, Arm KleidiAI SVE2.1 FP16 GEMM support, and additional RISC-V vector kernels ([#32715](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32715), [#32670](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32670), [#32710](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32710)).
- Enabled CoreML participation in device-based EP selection, including Apple Neural Engine selection through `PREFER_NPU` ([#31975](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31975)).
- Added workspace-memory accounting and verification for constrained-memory graph partitioning, alongside broader model, graph, and tensor validation ([#31962](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31962), [#32189](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32189)).

## Announcements & Compatibility

- [CUDA Plugin EP v0.3.0](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/tag/plugin-ep-cuda/v0.3.0) and WebGPU Plugin EP v0.5.0 are matched with ONNX Runtime 1.31.0. For **contrib-op compatibility**, core and the plugin must use the same contributed-operator schemas; building both from the **same ONNX Runtime revision** is recommended. Schema mismatches can cause incorrect execution or crashes and may not be detected during plugin registration.
- **`GatherBlockQuantized` behavior change:** out-of-range indices now produce zero output slices across CPU, CUDA, and WebGPU for both integer and floating-point quantized formats. This deliberately differs from ONNX `Gather` error semantics ([#32480](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32480)).
- **Experimental API migration:** model-package consumers should use `OrtApi::GetModelPackageApi` and the stable `OrtModelPackageApi` table. EPContext callback registration now uses stable APIs; the corresponding experimental lookup entries were removed. The stable native callback contract carries callback/state pointers, with payload limits enforced by application callbacks, bindings, or EPs rather than a native read-options policy ([#33166](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33166), [#32265](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32265)).
- **ACL EP is deprecated** and will be removed in a future release. Source builds using `--use_acl` now receive a deprecation warning ([#32564](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32564)).
- The ONNX dependency remains at **1.22.0**. The initial ONNX 1.23 integration was reverted pending upstream fixes; this release does not ship that integration's new opset or FLOAT6 support ([#33073](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33073)).
- Supported native builds now default to **1DS telemetry**. Windows TraceLogging remains selectable with `--use_windows_telemetry` or `onnxruntime_USE_WINDOWS_TELEMETRY=ON`; telemetry can be disabled with `--no_telemetry` ([#32384](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32384)).

## New Features

### Core APIs & Runtime

- Stabilized the model-package C and C++ APIs for loading packages, selecting compatible model variants, and creating sessions ([#33166](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33166)).
- Stabilized named EPContext data read/write callbacks for application-managed storage. Added EP support negotiation so registered callbacks do not silently fall back to filesystem I/O ([#32265](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32265)).
- Extended the Compile API to write external initializers and EP context data to buffers, enabling in-memory compilation workflows for models larger than 2 GB ([#31347](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31347)).
- Added workspace-memory accounting, source reporting, and post-partition reservation verification. Set `session.strict_workspace_verification=1` to fail initialization on workspace declaration overruns or nonzero orphaned reservations; strict verification is not supported for ORT-format model loads ([#31962](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31962), [#32189](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32189)).
- Added the opt-in source-build option `onnxruntime_DISABLE_DEVICE_DISCOVERY=ON` to skip platform accelerator probing and report only the CPU device ([#32592](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32592)).

### Shared Contrib Operators

These updates affect core operator schemas and cross-provider behavior, not only the separately released GPU plugins.

- Extended `EngramGate` and `NGramHashMapping` for Qwen4-Exp, and added `VarlenNGramHashMapping` for packed DeepSeek Engram batching with request-local history. Packed hashing also supports Qwen4-Exp head offsets, EOS resets, and segment boundaries ([#32285](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32285), [#32358](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32358), [#32467](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32467)).
- Added the `activation` attribute to `GatedRMSNorm` for SiLU, its Swish alias, and Sigmoid gating across CPU, CUDA, and WebGPU. SiLU remains the default ([#32512](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32512)).
- Added weightless hyper-connection operators `BranchwiseRMSNorm`, `ScaledSiLU`, `HyperConnectionPreMix`, and `HyperConnectionPostMix`, with CPU, CUDA, and WebGPU implementations ([#32687](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32687)).
- Extended `GatherBlockQuantized` to FP8/FP4 data, full-axis blocks, and scale broadcasting, and improved CPU UINT8 dequantization. See the out-of-range-index behavior change above ([#32480](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32480), [#32621](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32621)).

### Plugin Execution Provider Infrastructure

- Added support for statically linked plugin EPs, with a static WebGPU plugin build configuration ([#32395](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32395)).
- Preserved caller streams in single-tensor plugin data transfers and handled null plugin allocator returns ([#32666](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32666), [#32683](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32683)).
- Deduplicated AutoEP custom-op domains and corrected EP assignment reporting after NHWC layout transformation ([#32711](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32711), [#33184](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33184)).
- Added reference guidance for compiled-model compatibility validation, including multi-device scenarios ([#29168](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29168)).

## Execution Provider Updates

### CUDA EP

CUDA updates include sparse attention and packed continuous batching, expanded paged speculative decoding, INT2 and mixed-width QMoE execution, opt-in MatMul auto-tuning, improved MXFP4 support on Blackwell consumer GPUs, and reliability fixes.

See the [CUDA Plugin EP v0.3.0 release notes](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/tag/plugin-ep-cuda/v0.3.0) for detailed features, configuration options, limitations, and fixes. Most CUDA-specific PRs are covered there rather than repeated here. **Use the matched core/plugin combination and observe the contrib-op schema compatibility requirements above.**

### WebGPU EP

- Expanded generative AI support with sparse attention, packed continuous-batching indexers, GatedDeltaNet, and broader quantized MoE support, including block-scaled FP8 and INT2/mixed-width weights ([#32528](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32528), [#32529](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32529), [#32533](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32533), [#32618](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32618), [#32510](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32510), [#32794](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32794), [#32878](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32878)).
- Improved native provider integration and performance, including explicit session-stream concurrency, subgroup-matrix kernels on AMD GPUs, and standalone Dawn API package support ([#32587](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32587), [#32667](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32667), [#33006](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33006)).

Detailed WebGPU kernel additions, optimizations, and correctness fixes will be covered in the separate **WebGPU Plugin EP v0.5.0** release notes.

### CoreML EP

- Exposed CoreML through `OrtEpFactory`, device enumeration, `SessionOptionsAppendExecutionProvider_V2`, and EP selection policies. NPU selection requires iOS 16/macOS 13 or later; GPU selection requires iOS 15/macOS 12 or later. In builds advertising both CoreML and WebGPU for the same Apple GPU, `PREFER_GPU`/`MAX_PERFORMANCE` select CoreML through the existing EP-name tie-breaker; WebGPU remains available through explicit device selection ([#31975](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31975)).

### WebNN EP

- Added `GroupNormalization`, `GroupNorm`, and `SkipGroupNorm` support ([#32606](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32606)).
- Supported NHWC `Resize` by inferring `resample2d` axes and fixed `ConvTranspose` shape-arithmetic overflow ([#32628](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32628), [#32661](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32661)).

### Other Execution Providers

- Fixed a CANN deadlock during parallel execution and concurrent XNNPACK allocator initialization ([#29740](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29740), [#32489](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32489)).
- Validated DirectML upload-heap allocations and corrected `Resize` ROI axis expansion ([#32745](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32745), [#32747](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32747)).

## CPU & Core Optimizations

### Model Loading, MLAS, and CPU Kernels

- Parallelized eligible CPU weight prepacking during session initialization using the intra-op thread pool. Cross-session shared prepacked-weight caching retains its serialized path ([#31691](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31691)).
- Accelerated block-wise INT4/INT8 QMoE CPU experts with prepacked MLAS QNBit kernels and grouped dispatch. Added a `QMoE` `accuracy_level` attribute and the `ORT_QMOE_CPU_QNBIT_GEMM` override; INT4 uses FP32 activations by default, while `accuracy_level=4` opts into INT8 activation computation. INT8-weight experts use INT8 activations on the new path ([#32644](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32644), [#32668](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32668)).
- Added opt-in CPU `MatMulNBits` FP32 throughput mode with `mlas.qnbit.force_fp32=1` for eligible x86/x64 FP32-input, 4-bit, block-size-32, accuracy-level-4 nodes. It selects one numerical path for the whole session, is disabled by default, and trades single-request latency for batched throughput ([#31723](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31723)).
- Added AVX2/FMA/F16C FP16 LayerNorm/RMSNorm kernels and an AVX-512 sliding-window NCHWc depthwise-convolution kernel ([#32715](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32715), [#32749](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32749)).
- Integrated KleidiAI SVE2.1 FP16 GEMM with per-thread vector-length validation, retaining SME/SME2 priority where available. Updated KleidiAI to 1.30.0 ([#32670](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32670)).
- Optimized RISC-V RVV kernels and added RVV LinearAttention and FP32 minimum/maximum reduction kernels ([#32540](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32540), [#32710](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32710)).
- Reduced coordinate and memory-access work in CPU `Col2Im`/`Im2col`, accelerated adjacent-axis-group `Transpose`, reduced repeated scans in 1D `MaxPool`, and optimized `BatchNormalization` for NC inputs ([#32698](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32698), [#32800](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32800), [#32817](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32817), [#32891](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32891), [#32936](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32936), [#33113](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33113)).
- Enabled CPU INT8/UINT32 `Where` kernels and independent scale/output types in `DequantizeLinear`; avoided unused dynamic QGEMM packed-buffer allocations ([#32846](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32846), [#32728](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32728), [#32879](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32879)).

### Graph Optimization & Quantization Tools

- Added BatchNormalization fusion into `ConvTranspose` ([#29542](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29542)).
- Prevented unsupported CPU GELU/QuickGELU fusions, preserved public and shared graph values during fusion, and limited transpose movement through shared outputs to cases where it can cancel ([#32427](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32427), [#32431](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32431), [#32991](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32991), [#32868](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32868)).
- Fixed LayerNorm fusion with zero normalized dimensions, Reshape fusion with node-produced shape inputs, duplicate node names during QDQ fusion, and `MatMulNBits` bias fusion with prepacked weights ([#33079](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33079), [#33091](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33091), [#33115](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33115), [#32973](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32973)).
- Retained optimized models when quantization preprocessing skips shape inference, raised model IR to version 10 when the quantizer emits INT4/UINT4 tensors, and avoided intermediate overflow when computing quantization ranges ([#32803](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32803), [#33068](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33068), [#33104](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33104)).
- Corrected symbolic shape inference for `Shape` `start`/`end`, missing `ConstantOfShape` values during FP16 conversion, and packed `GatedDeltaNet` inputs. Preserved nested-graph serialization and FP16 `Cast` fallback consistency ([#33157](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33157), [#33089](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33089), [#32708](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32708), [#32727](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32727)).

## Security & Reliability

### Model Loading and Graph Validation

- Limited sparse-initializer dense allocations, checked sparse value cardinality, validated inline raw initializer sizes and ORT-format string initializers, and included string payloads in initializer size limits ([#32684](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32684), [#32753](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32753), [#32866](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32866), [#32751](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32751), [#32867](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32867)).
- Rejected duplicate model-local functions, recursive function graph attributes, non-control-flow nodes carrying subgraphs, and inputs supplied to zero-input schemas; bounded AOT function expansion ([#32750](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32750), [#32864](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32864), [#32641](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32641), [#32633](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32633), [#32662](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32662)).
- Validated optional graph inputs, `Constant` nodes, ORT-format input argument counts, and contrib-op shape inference; fixed out-of-bounds reads involving Loop/Scan initializers and shape-inference input data ([#32940](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32940), [#32865](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32865), [#32607](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32607), [#32609](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32609), [#32681](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32681)).
- Bound external-data validation to opened files and rejected model-package-controlled output-file options, including optimized-model output paths ([#33063](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33063), [#33059](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33059), [#33096](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33096)).
- Strengthened optimizer validation for initializer types, shape propagation, QDQ weight shapes and axes, and LabelEncoder fusion attributes ([#32647](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32647), [#32653](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32653), [#32648](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32648), [#32649](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32649), [#32726](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32726)).

### Runtime and Operator Correctness

- Serialized captured-graph replay with session runs and graph release for EPs that disallow concurrent runs. Checked CPU fallback assignments recursively in nested subgraphs ([#32902](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32902), [#32862](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32862)).
- Corrected conversions between ABI-stable C API tensor element types and ONNX TensorProto numbering, particularly `UINT2`, `INT2`, and `FLOAT8E8M0`, without renumbering public enum values. Fixed reuse of packed sub-byte buffers for full-byte tensors ([#33066](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33066), [#32611](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32611)).
- Strengthened recurrent-input rank, LayerNormalization axis, NCHWc layout, dynamic-pad, and `Resize` scale validation; used checked arithmetic for CPU LSTM and DynamicQuantizeLSTM state extents ([#32348](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32348), [#32555](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32555), [#32552](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32552), [#32557](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32557), [#33060](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33060), [#32654](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32654), [#32722](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32722), [#33128](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33128)).
- Fixed CPU MHA shared-cache length handling, large wrap-mode padding, empty `TopK`/`DFT` inputs, zero-channel `ConvTranspose`, and real-window handling for complex `STFT` signals ([#32723](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32723), [#32725](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32725), [#32724](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32724), [#33064](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33064), [#33136](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33136)).
- Corrected Arm64 FP16 GEMM Inf/NaN comparisons and NEON/SVE GELU/Erf overflow handling, fixed CPU INT2 per-axis `QuantizeLinear` output on the last axis, and avoided degenerate CPU GQA FlashAttention tiles when L2 cache size is unknown ([#31761](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31761), [#32631](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32631), [#33040](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33040), [#32786](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32786), [#33202](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33202)).

## Language Bindings & Web

- Added EPContext read/write callbacks in C#, Python, and Java ([#32270](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32270), [#32271](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32271), [#32305](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32305)).
- Added EPContext read callbacks in Node.js/React Native, Objective-C/Swift, and Rust. The JavaScript option is read-only and explicitly unsupported on Web/WASM ([#32308](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32308), [#32309](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32309), [#32310](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32310)).
- Added LoRA adapter support to the standard, non-proxy ONNX Runtime Web run path ([#32886](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32886)).
- Added Boolean tensor support in the Swift package and validated DLPack capsules before conversion ([#32215](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32215), [#33100](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33100)).

## Build, Packaging & Dependencies

- Validated CPU kernel registrations at compile time and improved CPU provider build time with an Eigen precompiled header ([#29649](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29649), [#32616](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32616)).
- Fixed Windows ARM64 `--enable_arm_neon_nchwc` handling and added Windows ARM64 GitHub Actions coverage ([#32094](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32094), [#32791](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32791)).
- Improved no-exceptions error handling for provider bridge initialization, optional OpenVINO probing, model-package metadata parsing, and partition configuration; fixed Clang portability issues ([#33051](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33051), [#33112](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33112), [#32883](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32883), [#32894](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32894), [#32853](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32853), [#33140](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33140)).
- Validated Protobuf consistency when ONNX comes from an installed package and repaired free-threaded Python wheel builds after the ONNX rollback ([#31346](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/31346), [#33105](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33105)).
- Updated Transformers to 5.3.0 and coremltools to 9.0, standardized telemetry dependency handling, and refreshed JavaScript dependencies and test lockfiles ([#32752](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32752), [#32586](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32586), [#32705](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32705), [#32996](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/32996), [#33003](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33003), [#33194](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/33194)).
